card.title: Confess First
card.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

mechanism: A conditions any answer about smoke on B first admitting increasingly specific printer misuse.
confusable: Unlike merely gathering information, A must make B's incriminating disclosure precede A's own.
comparison: D16-a drills into forbidden labels while delaying smoke explanation; D16-b drills into a false booking assurance before revealing the present story.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
